heading: **3 February 2026**
body:
*Updates at the beginning of the day*

1. In terms of TC, 293T cells were discarded and new media was prepared for GP5d cells. 50K cells/well were seeded for 3 12-well plates

*Diagnostic EcoRV digestion*

ELFlig2 and ELFlig3 were digested with EcoRV for 30 mins & 60 mins. Following samples were loaded on a 3% agarose gel for checking:

1. ELFlig2  
2. ELFlig3  
3. ELFlig2-EcoRV30m  
4. ELFlig3-EcoRV30m  
5. ELFlig2-EcoRV60m  
6. ELFlig3-EcoRV60m  
7. ELFlig1nuc

Run slowly at 85 V, 60 mins.

*SELEX checklist*

1\. Ligand plates

lig70N \- Prepare 15 X 400 \= 6000 uL of stock \[Requires 15 X 20 X 400 \= 120 ug DNA\]

lig200 \- Prepare 15 X 400 \= 6000 uL of stock \[Requires 15 X 20 X 400 \= 120 ug DNA\]

For each ligand split into 62.5 uL per well of a 96-well storage plate. From here aliquot evenly (15 uL per well) to NUNC 384-well plates. Store these ligand plates after labelling at \-20.

2\. Biotin Buffer plates

200 mL

| 1X TCAPT Block | 100 mL |
| :---- | :---- |
| Biotin | 0.49 g |
| Imidazole | 0.68 g |
| 10 M NaOH | 120 uL |

Make up the volume to 200 mL. DO NOT filter and aliquot 25 uL per well to 12 plates (needs \~120 mL buffer).

*Clean-up ELFlig1 nucleosomes (removal of free DNA population)*

### **Pre-Rinse Filter**

Add **500 µL** nuclease-free water to the filter (upper chamber) of a 100 kDa column.  
Centrifuge **10 min @ 14,000×g**.  
Discard the filtrate (flow-through).

**Adjust Sample to 200 µL**

Transfer your **200 µL** sample into a fresh low-binding tube.

**First Diafiltration**

Load the **200 µL** sample into the filter unit.  
Centrifuge **10 min @ 14,000×g**.  
Store the filtrate (contains imidazole, Tween, etc.) so that it can be checked for any remaining DNA, protein.

**Wash Step**

Add **200 µL** fresh Nucleosome Exchange Buffer E to the filter unit.  
Centrifuge **10 min @ 14,000×g**.  
Store the wash.

**Recover Buffer-Exchanged Sample**

Move the filter to a **new collection tube** (provided).  
Invert the unit and spin **5 min @ 1,500×g**.  
Discard the filter—your retentate is now in the tube.

The following tubes will now be generated based on these purifications:

| Sample | ng/uL |
| ----- | :---: |
| lig1\_FT | N/A |
| lig1\_W | N/A |
| lig1\_E | 5.62 |

MNase treatment was then performed for ELFlig1 and the concentrated/cleaned-up ELFlig1nuc sample.

Run these samples on a 3% agarose gel:

- ELFlig1  
- ELFlig1-MNase  
- ELFlig1nuc-MNase

*Transfection for Plasmid FIBER-Seq*

2.5 ug per well of a 12-well plate

Plate 1

| Gcla- (12) | Gcla- (18) | Hcla- (12) | Hcla- (18) |
| :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: |
| Gcla- (12) | Gcla- (18) | Hcla- (12) | Hcla- (18) |
|  |  |  |  |

Plate 2

| GCD- (12) | GCD- (18) | HCD- (12) | HCD- (18) |
| :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: |
| GCD- (12) | GCD- (18) | HCD- (12) | HCD- (18) |
|  |  |  |  |

Plate 3

| GCC- (12) | GCC- (18) | HCC- (12) | HCC- (18) |
| :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: |
| GCC- (12) | GCC- (18) | HCC- (12) | HCC- (18) |
|  |  |  |  |

T1 \= 250 uL Opti-MEM \+ 10 ug \+ 20 uL P3000

T2 \= 250 uL Opti-MEM \+ 15 uL Lipo3000

Add 125 uL of the mix per well of plates 

Nucleosome Buffer E

| Component | Stock | Final | Volume for 50 mL |
| ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- |
| **Tris pH 8** | **1 M** | **15 mM** | **0.75 mL (750 µL)** |
| **EDTA** | **0.5 M** | **1 mM** | **0.10 mL (100 µL)** |
| **EGTA** | **0.5 M** | **0.5 mM** | **0.05 mL (50 µL)** |
| **KCl** | **4 M** | **100 mM** | **1.25 mL** |
| **TCEP** | **(your stock)** | **same v/v as before** | **0.50 mL (500 µL)** |
| **Glycerol** | **100%** | **5% v/v** | **2.50 mL** |
| **Nuclease-free water** | **—** | **—** | **to 50.00 mL** |

100 mM TCEP ⇒ 0.29 g in 10 mL water
